papers.title: Understanding and Mitigating Bias Inheritance in LLM-based Data Augmentation on Downstream Tasks
papers.abstract: Generating synthetic datasets via large language models (LLMs) has emerged as a promising approach to improve LLM performance. However, LLMs inherently reflect biases in their training data, leading to a critical challenge: when models are trained on synthetic data, they may propagate and amplify the inherent biases that can significantly impact fairness and robustness on downstream tasks—a phenomenon we term bias inheritance. This work presents the first systematic investigation in understanding, analyzing, and mitigating bias inheritance. We fine-tune LLMs with a combined dataset of real and LLM-augmented data with varied bias ratio as the proportion of augmented data. Through systematic experiments across 10 classification and generation tasks, we analyze how 6 different types of biases manifest. Our results indicate that bias inheritance harms downstream task performance in bias directly-related classification and generation tasks. Then, our analysis identifies three key misalignment factors: misalignment of values, group data, and data distributions. Based on these insights, we propose three mitigation strategies: token-based, mask-based, and loss-based approaches, which can work differently on various tasks and bias, indicating the substantial challenges to mitigate bias inheritance. We hope this work can provide insights to the research of LLM data augmentation.

summary.takeaway: LLM 生成的合成数据中的偏见可能被继承并放大，损害下游公平性，且缓解并非易事。
summary.evidence: 在 10 项分类和生成任务上的实验表明，偏见继承会降低偏见相关任务的性能。
summary.limitations: 缓解策略在不同任务和偏见上的效果差异显著，表明面临巨大挑战。
summary.method: 在混合真实与合成数据、不同偏见比例下微调 LLM，并评估基于 token、mask 和 loss 的缓解策略。
summary.why_for_you: 对研究数据选择和可信 LLM 有重要意义，因为它揭示了合成增强中的偏见风险。
summary.problem: LLM 增强的训练数据将固有偏见传播至下游任务（偏见继承）。

signals.text: 首次系统性研究 LLM 数据增强中偏见继承，覆盖 10 项任务和 6 类偏见。
提出基于 token、mask 和 loss 的缓解方法，以解决偏见错位。
研究发现偏见继承损害下游性能，但缓解效果因任务和偏见而异。

deep_dive.overview: 本文研究了大型语言模型生成的合成数据如何继承并放大训练数据偏见（称为偏见继承）。通过在真实与 LLM 增强数据的混合数据集上进行微调并控制偏见比例，作者在十个分类和生成基准上考察了六类偏见。文中指出三种错位因素——价值观、群体数据和数据分布——并提出三种缓解策略（基于 token、mask、loss）。结果显示偏见相关任务性能下降，且缓解效果差异显著，凸显彻底解决偏见继承的难度。

methodology.title: Bias‑ratio 控制的微调
methodology.detail: 在真实与合成数据的混合上对 LLM 进行微调，改变增强数据（bias ratio）的比例，以研究其对下游性能的影响。

methodology.title: 缓解策略设计
methodology.detail: 提出三种方法：基于 token 的（调整 token 表示）、基于 mask 的（修改注意力掩码）和基于 loss 的（改变损失函数），用于抵消已识别的错位。

mechanism.title: 错位因素
mechanism.detail: 偏差继承源于真实与合成语料库之间在价值观、群体数据和整体数据分布上的错位。

mechanism.title: 缓解机制
mechanism.detail: 基于 token 的方法旨在重新加权有偏 token，基于 mask 的方法限制有偏注意力模式，基于 loss 的方法在训练中惩罚有偏预测。

experiments.title: 任务套件与偏差分类法
experiments.detail: 评估了十个 classification 和 generation 任务，涵盖六种不同的 bias 类型；系统性地改变 bias ratios，以观察 inheritance effects。

experiments.title: mitigation 评估
experiments.detail: 在任务套件中应用每种 mitigation 策略，测量 downstream performance 的变化，以评估其在各 bias 和任务上的有效性。

findings.title: Bias inheritance 降低性能
findings.detail: 在与 bias 直接相关的 classification 和 generation 任务中，较高的 synthetic bias ratios 导致 downstream accuracy 和 fairness metrics 可测量的下降。

findings.title: 异构 mitigation 结果
findings.detail: Token‑、mask‑、和 loss‑based 方法在部分 bias‑task 组合上提升 performance，但在其他组合上失效或出现回退，凸显 task‑specific 挑战。

contributions: 系统性研究 LLM 生成的合成数据中的偏差继承。
识别导致偏差传播的三个关键错位因素。
提出三种缓解策略（基于 token、基于 mask、基于 loss）。
limitations: 缓解策略在不同任务和偏差类型上的效果差异显著，表明普遍解决偏差继承面临重大挑战。
open_questions: 如何统一缓解技术，以在多样任务中持续降低偏差继承？
哪些定量指标最能衡量合成数据集中的偏差继承程度？
能否将偏差感知的数据选择标准整合到 LLM 增强流水线中，以预先限制偏差传播？

papers.title: User Perceptions vs. Proxy LLM Judges: Privacy and Helpfulness in LLM Responses to Privacy-Sensitive Scenarios
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly being adopted for tasks like drafting emails, summarizing meetings, and answering health questions. In these settings, users may need to share private information (e.g., contact details, health records). To evaluate LLMs' ability to identify and redact such information, prior work introduced real-life, scenario-based benchmarks (e.g., ConfAIde, PrivacyLens) and found that LLMs can leak private information in complex scenarios. However, these evaluations relied on proxy LLMs to judge the helpfulness and privacy-preservation quality of LLM responses, rather than directly measuring users' perceptions. To understand how users perceive the helpfulness and privacy-preservation quality of LLM responses to privacy-sensitive scenarios, we conducted a user study ($n=94$) using 90 PrivacyLens scenarios. We found that users had low agreement with each other when evaluating identical LLM responses. In contrast, five proxy LLMs reached high agreement, yet each proxy LLM had low correlation with users' evaluations. These results indicate that proxy LLMs cannot accurately estimate users' wide range of perceptions of utility and privacy in privacy-sensitive scenarios. We discuss the need for more user-centered studies to measure LLMs' ability to help users while preserving privacy, and for improving alignment between LLMs and users in estimating perceived privacy and utility.

summary.takeaway: 代理 LLM 评审无法预测用户在隐私敏感情境下对隐私和有用性的感知。
summary.evidence: 用户间评审一致性低，而五个代理 LLM 的一致性高，但与用户评分相关性低。
summary.limitations: 缺乏对 90 PrivacyLens 场景之外的泛化证据。
summary.method: 对 94 名参与者进行的用户研究，评估 90 个 PrivacyLens 场景下 LLM 响应的隐私性和实用性。
summary.why_for_you: 对可信 LLM 研究重要，因为它揭示了基于模型的代理与人类隐私判断之间的不一致。
summary.problem: 当前评估依赖代理 LLM，而非直接测量用户对隐私保护 LLM 行为的判断。

deep_dive.overview: 本文探讨代理 LLM 评审能否替代人类对 LLM 生成响应的隐私和实用性评估。通过招募 94 名参与者对 90 个真实 PrivacyLens 场景的响应进行评分，作者测量用户间的一致性并与五个代理 LLM 的共识比较。结果显示人类意见分歧显著，代理模型内部一致却与人类判断偏离，凸显当前评估实践的缺口并推动以用户为中心的评估方法。
open_questions: 如何设计评估指标以捕捉用户对隐私感知的广泛差异？
哪些方法能使代理 LLM 判断与隐私敏感情境下多样的人类判断保持一致？
limitations: 缺乏对 90 PrivacyLens 场景之外的泛化证据。

signals.text: 代理 LLM 评审在 90 个 PrivacyLens 场景（94 名用户）中对隐私和有用性的人工判断预测效果差。
进行用户研究，对 LLM 响应的隐私和实用性进行评分，并将用户间一致性与五个代理 LLM 进行比较。
用户一致性低（低的 inter‑rater 相关），而代理 LLM 一致性高但与用户相关性低。

methodology.title: User Study Design
methodology.detail: 94 名参与者分别评估 90 个 PrivacyLens 场景下的 LLM 响应，给出对隐私保护和有用性的感知评分。

mechanism.title: Misalignment Between Proxy and Human Judgments
mechanism.detail: 代理 LLM 在内部产生一致评分，但这些评分与多样的人类评估相关性差，表明存在系统性评估偏差。

experiments.title: Evaluation of Proxy LLMs vs. Human Ratings
experiments.detail: 五个代理 LLM 对相同响应生成判断；计算了代理之间的一致性以及与人类评分的相关性。

findings.title: Low Human Agreement
findings.detail: 人类参与者对相同 LLM 响应的评分一致性低。

findings.title: High Proxy Agreement, Low Correlation
findings.detail: 代理 LLM 达到高内部一致性，但与人类评估的相关性低。

contributions: 提供实证表明代理 LLM 评审未能反映用户对隐私和实用性的感知。

papers.title: OPUS: Towards Efficient and Principled Data Selection in Large Language Model Pre-training in Every Iteration
papers.abstract: As high-quality public text approaches exhaustion, a phenomenon known as the Data Wall—LLM pre-training is shifting from more tokens to better tokens. However, existing methods either rely on heuristic static filters that ignore training dynamics, or use dynamic yet optimizer-agnostic criteria based on raw gradients. We propose OPUS (Optimizer-induced Projected Utility Selection), a dynamic framework that defines utility in the optimizer-induced update space. OPUS scores candidates by projecting their effective updates, shaped by modern optimizers, onto a target direction derived from a stable, in-distribution proxy. To ensure scalability, we employ Ghost technique with CountSketch for computational efficiency, and Boltzmann sampling for data diversity, incurring only 4.7% additional compute overhead. OPUS achieves remarkable results across diverse corpora, quality tiers, optimizers, and model scales. It also outperforms previous data selection methods across different stages of training, including from-scratch pre-training and also mid-training. Beyond online selection, the OPUS utility score also demonstrates potential as a static filter for flagging and removing toxic documents from contaminated training corpora prior to training.

summary.takeaway: OPUS 通过将 optimizer‑induced 更新投影到 target direction，高效选择更高效用的训练标记。
summary.evidence: OPUS 在语料库、optimizers 和模型规模上均优于已有 data‑selection 方法，且仅增加 4.7% 的计算开销。
summary.method: OPUS 通过使用 Ghost、CountSketch 和 Boltzmann 采样，将现代优化器塑造的有效更新投影到由稳定分布代理得到的方向上，为每个候选项打分。
summary.why_for_you: 如果您需要利用训练动态和 optimizer 行为的 data‑selection 方法以实现高效 LLM pre‑training，则本研究相关。
summary.problem: Data Wall 限制了 LLM pre‑training，因为高质量公共文本已枯竭，且现有过滤器忽视训练动态或对 optimizer‑agnostic 不敏感。

signals.text: OPUS 引入了动态、optimizer‑aware 的数据选择框架，通过投影效用为训练样本打分。
OPUS 使用 Ghost 技术结合 CountSketch 与 Boltzmann 采样，将 optimizer‑shaped 的有效更新投影到 target direction。
OPUS 仅增加 4.7% 的计算开销，却在语料库、optimizers 和模型规模上实现更佳性能。

deep_dive.overview: OPUS 通过在 optimizer‑induced 更新空间定义效用来应对 Data Wall。它利用现代优化器计算的有效更新，将其投影到由稳定分布代理得到的 target direction 上，为每个候选标记计算效用分数。通过 Ghost 技术结合 CountSketch 实现可扩展性，并使用 Boltzmann 采样保持数据多样性。跨不同语料库、质量层级、optimizers 和模型规模的实验表明，相比现有静态和动态选择方法，OPUS 能持续提升性能，且仅带来约 4.7% 的计算增量。该效用分数亦可用作有害数据的静态过滤器。

methodology.title: Utility Scoring via Projection
methodology.detail: 每个候选的有效更新（由 optimizer 产生）被投影到反映稳定分布内 proxy 的目标方向上，得到标量效用分数。

methodology.title: 可扩展计算
methodology.detail: Ghost 技术结合 CountSketch 高效近似投影，实现每次迭代评分而不会产生过大开销。

methodology.title: 通过 Boltzmann 采样实现多样性
methodology.detail: 效用分数通过 Boltzmann 分布转化为选择概率，既保证数据多样性，又倾向于高效用样本。

mechanism.title: 优化器诱导的更新空间
mechanism.detail: 现代优化器（如 Adam）生成的更新定义了一个向量空间；OPUS 利用该空间捕获原始梯度方法中缺失的训练动态。

mechanism.title: 来自稳定代理的目标方向
mechanism.detail: 稳定的分布内数据集提供参考方向；将更新投影到该方向上可衡量与期望学习信号的对齐程度。

experiments.title: 实证评估
experiments.detail: 在多个覆盖不同质量层级的语料库上评估 OPUS，使用多种优化器和模型规模，涵盖从头 pre‑training 和 mid‑training 阶段；并与之前的 static filters 和 dynamic gradient‑based selectors 进行比较。

findings.title: 性能提升
findings.detail: 在所有设置下，OPUS 始终优于以往 data selection methods，展示了对语料类型、优化器选择和模型规模的鲁棒性。

findings.title: 计算效率
findings.detail: OPUS 额外的计算成本限制在每次 training iteration 的 4.7%。

findings.title: 静态过滤能力
findings.detail: OPUS utility score 可 offline 用于标记并在 training 前移除 toxic documents。

contributions: Dynamic optimizer‑aware 投影效用的数据选择。
使用 Ghost 技术和 CountSketch 的可扩展投影。
展示 utility score 作为静态 toxic‑data 过滤器。
limitations: 在可用来源中未说明。
open_questions: OPUS 在极大模型（例如 >10B 参数）和海量 token 池上的可扩展性如何？
不同的 stable in‑distribution 代理选择对 utility 估计的影响是什么？
OPUS 对 optimizer 超参数以及 Ghost/CountSketch 近似细节的敏感性如何？

papers.title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) combines student-generated rollouts with dense token-level supervision from a teacher. Existing work has mainly studied its algorithmic behavior, leaving the role of training data unclear. We examine this role at the data-minimal limit by training on a single query. One-shot OPD keeps improving for hundreds of steps and recovers most of full-data OPD's gain across task domains and model families. We explain this result through the states visited during training and the rate at which the student aligns with the teacher. We measure \emph{state coverage}, the fraction of the states full-data OPD visits that a query set's rollouts reach. A single query already reaches \(71.5\%\), most of it within the first 100 steps. Adding semantically distinct queries raises coverage and validation accuracy together, until 16 queries reach \(98.9\%\) and match full-data training. Yet alignment slows at a similar pace whether OPD trains on one query or the whole dataset, and even a fixed set of states takes hundreds of steps to absorb. OPD is therefore data-overfed but algorithm-starved. Its rollouts quickly expose broad supervision, while the student absorbs that supervision increasingly slowly. The state-coverage result extends to multi-teacher OPD, where 16 semantically diverse queries per domain match full-data MOPD. As a further stress test, content-light templates and off-domain WildChat queries also approach the real-query baseline. Task content and induced state coverage can therefore come apart. We hope these findings direct future work toward the step efficiency of OPD, and prompt a re-examination of the data and the mechanisms behind its recent successes in frontier post-training.

summary.takeaway: 使用单一查询的一次性 on-policy 蒸馏可恢复全数据 OPD 在任务和模型系列中的大部分性能提升。
summary.method: 作者在单一查询（一次性）和小规模语义多样的查询集上训练 OPD，测量 state coverage 与 alignment dynamics。
summary.problem: 训练数据的数量和多样性对 OPD 效果的影响尚未系统研究。
summary.limitations: state coverage 基于全数据 rollout 构建的参考进行评估，且对所有簇一视同仁；MOPD 实验仅覆盖三个领域，每个领域只有一个 teacher。
summary.evidence: 单一查询实现 71.5% 的 state coverage 并恢复全数据 OPD 大部分验证增益，16 个查询则达到 98.9% 覆盖率并匹配全数据性能。
summary.why_for_you: 鉴于您关注 on-policy 蒸馏和数据选择，该工作表明 state-coverage 指标可用于指导最小查询选择，以实现高效 OPD。

signals.text: 一次性 OPD 使用单查询可恢复约 71.5% 的 state coverage 与大部分全数据增益。
state coverage 通过对全数据状态聚类并评估查询集的 rollouts 来衡量。
16 个语义多样查询实现 98.9% 覆盖率并匹配全数据性能，但 coverage 仅为代理指标。

deep_dive.overview: 本文通过将数据集缩减至单查询（一次性 OPD）或小规模语义多样查询集，研究 OPD 实际所需的训练数据量。提出了 state‑coverage 指标，用于量化全数据 OPD 访问的状态中有多少被有限查询的 rollouts 覆盖。四个任务域和三种模型系列的实验表明，单查询已覆盖 71.5% 的状态空间并恢复大部分验证增益，16 个查询则达到 98.9% 覆盖率并完全匹配全数据结果。作者认为 OPD 数据充裕但算法受限，teacher 信号的吸收速率限制了训练时长。

methodology.title: 单次 OPD 训练
methodology.detail: 在单个查询生成的 rollout 上训练 student，最多 1000 步，在每个访问的状态施加密集的 token‑level teacher 监督。

methodology.title: 状态覆盖度测量
methodology.detail: 对 full‑data OPD 运行期间访问的所有状态进行聚类，然后计算给定查询集的 rollout 所到达的聚类比例。

methodology.title: 固定状态消融
methodology.detail: 复用一次从初始 student 采样的 64 条静态轨迹，以检验长时间训练是否需要新状态。

methodology.title: 多教师扩展 (MOPD)
methodology.detail: 对 multi‑teacher OPD 进行相同的 query‑diversity 分析，在三个领域中每个领域使用 16 条查询。

mechanism.title: 数据过载、算法受限假设
mechanism.detail: 查询在早期会产生大量状态，提供丰富的监督（data‑overfed），但无论查询数量多少，student 与 teacher 的对齐率都会类似下降，使得优化器成为瓶颈（algorithm‑starved）。

mechanism.title: 吸收率
mechanism.detail: 定义为每次更新中减少的剩余 teacher‑student token‑level 差距的比例；在单次和 full‑data 运行中均观察到该比例在数百步内稳步下降。

experiments.title: 领域与模型套件
experiments.detail: 四个领域（math、code generation、instruction following、agentic tool use），配有学生‑教师对，例如 R1‑Distill‑1.5B ↔ JustRL‑1.5B、Llama‑3B‑It ↔ GT‑Llama‑3B‑Math、以及 Qwen‑Coder‑1.5B ↔ Hammer‑1.5B。

experiments.title: 指标与基线
experiments.detail: 验证准确率（%）、state coverage（%）、top‑16 token overlap、以及 overlap‑token advantage；基线为 full‑data OPD 和 full‑data MOPD。

findings.title: 单查询有效性
findings.detail: One‑shot OPD 在前 100 步内达到 71.5% 的 state coverage，并在所有领域恢复了大部分 full‑data OPD 的增益。

findings.title: 查询多样性扩展
findings.detail: 加入语义上不同的查询可同步提升 coverage 与 accuracy；16 条查询实现 98.9% 的 coverage，并匹配 full‑data OPD/MOPD 的性能。

findings.title: 固定状态运行
findings.detail: 使用静态状态集合得到相似长度的学习曲线，表明新生成状态并非导致训练延长的原因。

contributions: 展示 OPD 只需一次查询即可实现接近完整性能，引入 state coverage 作为 data‑efficiency 指标，并揭示 OPD 的 data‑overfed/algorithm‑starved 特性。
limitations: state coverage 是相对于 full‑data rollout 的语义层代理，等权所有簇，未反映内在信号强度。
影响 absorption rate 的因素尚未确定。
MOPD 实验仅覆盖三个领域且每个仅有一位 teacher，尚未验证对更多 teacher 与领域的可扩展性。
open_questions: 如何在没有 full‑data 参考的情况下估计 state coverage，以实现主动数据选择？
哪些算法改进可提升 absorption rate，使 OPD 更具 step‑efficiency？
query‑diversity 的结论是否在多 teacher、多 domain 场景以及更大 student model 中仍然成立？

papers.title: Can LLMs Design Video Coding Tools? A Case Study on Planar Mode
papers.abstract: This paper explores whether large language models (LLMs) can design video coding tools, a highly challenging task due to the intricate algorithmic coupling of tool modifications. In particular, we present an empirical case study on the Planar mode, a long-standing intra prediction tool in video coding standards. Our experiments operate within a generation-and-evaluation loop, with the LLM generating new Planar predictors, encoder trials evaluating their coding performance, and the LLM re-generating refined implementations based on the evaluation feedback. We first examine directly replacing the default Planar mode in the Fraunhofer Versatile Video Encoder (VVenC) under its faster preset. Experimental results demonstrate that the LLM-generated mode can outperform the conventional Planar mode on this lightweight toolset, achieving 0.18% bitrate savings with 0.4% complexity overhead on the standard benchmark. We further extend our evaluation to the Enhanced Compression Model (ECM). Leveraging newly introduced directional Planar modes, we investigate two integration strategies: directly replacing them, and introducing the LLM-generated predictor as an additional prediction mode with new syntax elements. The empirical results suggest that both strategies can yield coding gains under a constrained low-resolution setting. Overall, this study offers preliminary evidence and practical insights, highlighting both the potential and open challenges of LLM-based coding tool design.

summary.problem: 视频编码工具的设计在算法上相互耦合，且传统上依赖专家。
summary.method: 生成‑评估循环让 LLM 编写预测器代码，编码器测量性能，LLM 再优化代码。
summary.limitations: 实验仅限于轻量预设和低分辨率 ECM 场景。

papers.title: Distance Is Not Enough: Forget-Retain Alignment Gap Predicts LLM Relearning Robustness
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning aims to make a model forget specific data, yet unlearned LLMs often fail to stay unlearned: brief fine-tuning can revive removed knowledge. Existing robustness predictors rely on global weight-space displacement, but distance alone can be misleading when random or destructive updates collapse performance. We argue that relearning robustness depends on update structure: robust unlearning should affect forget-critical weights while sparing retain-critical ones. We introduce the Forget-Retain Alignment Gap (FRAG), a training-free predictor that scores an update's forget-retain alignment without running a relearning attack, and separates selective from dense updates more reliably than global distance. Building on the forget-critical, retain-sparing principle, Forget-Retain Pruning (FRP) improves relearning robustness. Our results suggest that weight selectivity better explains robustness than distance alone. Code is available at https://github.com/Yi1-Chen/FRAG.

summary.why_for_you: 高效对抗训练专家会看重 FRAG 的 training-free 对齐指标，用于在无需重新学习攻击的情况下评估忘记鲁棒性。
summary.limitations: FRAG 需要校准数据，且主要在 transformer 架构上进行评估。
summary.problem: 现有的忘记方法因对权重更新缺乏足够的结构性保证，无法防止重新学习攻击。
summary.method: FRAG 通过 activation-normalized 权重重要性得分计算忘记-保留对齐差距；FRP 根据这些得分剪枝权重。
summary.evidence: 在多种忘记方法和模型中，FRAG 与实际重新学习鲁棒性的相关性比全局距离更可靠。
summary.takeaway: FRAG 与 FRP 通过优先考虑忘记-保留对齐而非全局距离，提升重新学习鲁棒性。

papers.title: Are LLM-Enhanced GNNs Privacy-Safe?
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently advanced graph neural networks (GNNs) by enriching node representations with semantic information, giving rise to LLM-enhanced GNNs that achieve substantial performance gains. However, their vulnerability to privacy attacks, in which adversaries infer sensitive information from model outputs, remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic evaluation of privacy risks in LLM-enhanced GNNs through a unified framework consisting of five stages: (1) dataset preparation, (2) victim model training, (3) privacy attack, (4) risk assessment, and (5) defense analysis. Specifically, we conduct experiments on six real-world text-attributed graph datasets covering diverse domains. We consider six representative privacy attack methods targeting three fundamental threats, namely link, label, and membership inference, and construct 42 victim model configurations by combining multiple LLM-based feature enhancers with representative GNN backbones. Extensive experiments show that, despite their utility improvements, LLM-enhanced GNNs consistently exhibit increased vulnerability to privacy attacks compared to shallow text representation baselines. Further analysis reveals that semantic enrichment amplifies link-, label-, and membership-related signals in the embedding space, making them more exploitable by inference attacks. Finally, we evaluate differential privacy as a defense strategy and show that, while it can partially mitigate privacy risks, it introduces significant utility degradation, highlighting a fundamental privacy-utility trade-off in LLM-enhanced graph learning. Overall, this work provides a comprehensive understanding of privacy risks in LLM-enhanced GNNs and offers practical insights for developing more secure and trustworthy graph learning systems.

summary.takeaway: LLM‑增强的 GNN 在提升节点分类准确率的同时，会显著增加对链接、标签和成员推断攻击的易感性，差分隐私只能在高代价的实用性损失下部分缓解。
summary.why_for_you: 符合您对可信 LLM 的兴趣，揭示了 LLM‑增强图学习中的隐私漏洞及其权衡。
summary.method: 作者提出统一的五阶段框架，在六个文本属性图数据集、42 种受害模型配置和六类代表性推断攻击上评估隐私，并考察差分隐私作为防御手段。
summary.limitations: 在可获取的来源中未说明。
summary.evidence: 大量实验表明，LLM‑增强的 GNN 相较于浅层基线泄露更多隐私，使用差分隐私可降低泄露但会显著下降分类准确率。
summary.problem: 尚未系统研究融合 LLM‑生成节点嵌入的图神经网络的隐私风险。

deep_dive.overview: 本文提供系统的 LLM‑增强图神经网络隐私评估流水线，涵盖数据集准备、使用解释式和嵌入式 LLM 增强的受害模型训练、针对链接、标签和成员信息的六种推断攻击、定量风险评估以及差分隐私防御研究。六个真实文本属性图的实验表明，语义增强提升分类性能的同时也放大了隐私泄露信号，且差分隐私只能在牺牲准确率的情况下提供部分保护。

papers.title: Making Clinical Language Models Auditable: Concept-Guided Fine-Tuning for Robust Prediction
papers.abstract: Clinical language models can achieve strong in-hospital accuracy yet fail under deployment shifts because they exploit note-specific artifacts (e.g., templates, separators, boilerplate) that do not reflect patient state. We propose CAST (Concept-guided Artifact Suppression Tuning), an SAE-based framework for auditable clinical text classification. CAST uses Sparse Autoencoders to expose sparse, human-auditable features from intermediate Transformer activations, labels SAE latents with an LLM-assisted interpretation pipeline and ICD-10 retrieval constraints, suppresses verified artifact latents via residual subtraction during fine-tuning, and provides post-hoc per-concept attributions for auditing model decisions. On MIMIC-IV discharge-note mortality prediction, CAST improves over its corresponding fine-tuned encoder baselines and remains competitive with strong LLM baselines, while producing a feature-level audit trail of the clinical concepts that support each prediction and the artifact concepts suppressed during training.

summary.takeaway: We propose CAST (Concept-guided Artifact Suppression Tuning), an SAE-based framework for auditable clinical text classification.
summary.problem: Clinical language models can achieve strong in-hospital accuracy yet fail under deployment shifts because they exploit note-specific artifacts (e.g., templates, separators, boilerplate) that do not reflect patient state.
summary.method: We propose CAST (Concept-guided Artifact Suppression Tuning), an SAE-based framework for auditable clinical text classification.
summary.evidence: On MIMIC-IV discharge-note mortality prediction, CAST improves over its corresponding fine-tuned encoder baselines and remains competitive with strong LLM baselines, while producing a feature-level audit trail of the clinical concepts that support each prediction and the artifact concepts suppressed during training.
summary.limitations: The abstract does not state complete limitations; verify the experimental setup, baselines, and scope before relying on the result.
summary.why_for_you: Matches your research profile: Efficient adversarial training, LLM loss landscape.

papers.title: Beyond Global Scalars: Synergizing Token-Level Statistics and Deep Semantics for Adversarial AIGC Text Detection
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of large language models necessitates robust machine-generated text detection. Existing paradigms typically follow two isolated tracks. Training-free methods rely on global statistical scalars such as perplexity, while training-based methods utilize semantic hidden states. Both approaches exhibit fundamental vulnerabilities in adversarial scenarios. Global scalars act as lossy compressions that obscure local probabilistic burstiness in interleaved texts, whereas pure semantic models overfit to specific fingerprints and remain susceptible to spoofing. To expose these flaws, we introduce MOSAIC, a comprehensive adversarial benchmark comprising 16000 samples across a full-granularity attack spectrum. To address these challenges, we propose NeuroStat, an end-to-end framework bridging the statistical and semantic gap. NeuroStat captures uncompressed token-level probabilistic logits alongside deep semantic hidden states from a single causal language model backbone. We fuse these heterogeneous signals through Macro-State Residual Modulation, which adaptively calibrates local convolutional features using global uncertainty indicators. Orthogonal and contrastive losses further ensure the learning of complementary representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuroStat maintains exceptional robustness on MOSAIC compared to the severe degradation of state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new standard for adversarial text detection. Code and the MOSAIC benchmark are available at https://github.com/TencentBAC/NeuroStat.

summary.takeaway: NeuroStat fuses token‑level probability logits with deep semantic hidden states to achieve superior adversarial text detection.
summary.problem: Training‑free global scalar detectors and training‑based semantic models both collapse under adversarial interleaving and spoofing attacks.
summary.method: NeuroStat uses a dual‑branch architecture that extracts token‑level log‑probability trajectories and hidden states from a single causal LM, fusing them via Macro‑State Residual Modulation and auxiliary orthogonal/contrastive losses.
summary.evidence: On the MOSAIC benchmark NeuroStat (Qwen2‑0.5B) attains an overall AUROC of 83.4%, surpassing the next best DetectAnyLLM (77.1%) while training on only 500 pairs.
summary.limitations: Evaluation is limited to English texts, requires token‑level logits unavailable from many closed‑source APIs, and incurs ~10% higher latency and memory than the strongest baseline.
summary.why_for_you: The work demonstrates a data‑efficient, robust detection model that aligns with your interest in efficient adversarial training.

signals.text: NeuroStat attains the highest MOSAIC AUROC of 83.4%, outpacing all prior MGTD detectors.
Fusion via Macro-State Residual Modulation combines token‑level logits and hidden states with orthogonal and contrastive losses.
On MOSAIC, NeuroStat (Qwen2‑0.5B) reaches 83.4% AUROC versus DetectAnyLLM’s 77.1%, using only 500 training pairs.

deep_dive.overview: The paper identifies that existing machine‑generated text detectors either compress token probabilities into global scalars or rely solely on semantic fingerprints, both of which are vulnerable to sophisticated adversarial attacks such as interleaved human‑AI writing and statistical hijacking. To expose these weaknesses, the authors release MOSAIC, a 16k‑sample benchmark covering 36 attack types. NeuroStat addresses the gap by jointly processing uncompressed token‑level logits and deep hidden states from a single causal LM, merging them through Macro‑State Residual Modulation and reinforcing complementary learning with orthogonal and contrastive objectives. Extensive experiments on MOSAIC and MIRAGE show NeuroStat’s robustness and data efficiency, while ablations confirm each component’s contribution. Limitations include English‑only evaluation, reliance on log‑probability access, and modest computational overhead.

methodology.title: Probabilistic Trajectories Branch (TF)
methodology.detail: Extracts the shifted log‑probability trajectory of each token, processes it with a hierarchical 1D‑CNN to capture local burstiness, and outputs a feature vector c.

methodology.title: Semantic Branch (TB)
methodology.detail: Feeds the last‑layer hidden states H from the same backbone into a parallel encoder to capture contextual semantic artifacts.

methodology.title: Macro‑State Residual Modulation (MSRM)
methodology.detail: Conditions the CNN features on global uncertainty indicators—mean entropy (Ē) and mean log‑rank (R̄)—to calibrate local signals with overall model confidence.

methodology.title: Auxiliary Losses
methodology.detail: Applies a supervised contrastive loss to enlarge inter‑class margins and an orthogonal penalty to keep TF and TB representations decorrelated.

mechanism.title: Fusion via MSRM
mechanism.detail: MSRM adds a residual term derived from Ē and R̄ to the CNN feature map, allowing the model to distinguish genuine low‑probability human words from AI‑generated anomalies, while the orthogonal loss forces the two branches to encode distinct information.

experiments.title: Benchmarking on MOSAIC and MIRAGE
experiments.detail: Evaluated NeuroStat with Qwen2‑0.5B and Qwen3.5‑0.8B backbones against 11 state‑of‑the‑art MGTD baselines on MOSAIC (16k samples, 8 attack categories) and MIRAGE (multiple domains). Training used only 500 human‑AI passage pairs; AUROC and TPR@5% were reported.

findings.title: Superior Adversarial Robustness
findings.detail: NeuroStat (Qwen2‑0.5B) achieved 83.4% overall AUROC on MOSAIC, with per‑attack scores up to 89.9% (Interleaved) and consistently outperformed all baselines, whose AUROCs dropped dramatically under targeted attacks.

findings.title: Data Efficiency and Generalization
findings.detail: With just 250 training pairs NeuroStat reached 78.9% MOSAIC AUROC; on MIRAGE‑SIG it obtained AUROCs of 0.9954, 0.9739, and 0.9665 across three tasks, demonstrating strong cross‑domain transfer.

contributions: Dual‑branch detection framework NeuroStat that jointly leverages token‑level logits and semantic hidden states.
Macro‑State Residual Modulation for adaptive fusion of local and global uncertainty signals.
MOSAIC, a comprehensive adversarial MGTD benchmark covering a full‑granularity attack taxonomy.
limitations: Evaluated only on English‑language corpora; multilingual or domain‑specific (e.g., code, legal) performance is untested.
Requires access to full token‑level log probabilities, limiting applicability to closed‑source APIs.
Introduces approximately 10% higher inference latency and memory usage compared to the strongest baseline.
open_questions: How can NeuroStat be adapted to multilingual or low‑resource language settings?
Can surrogate log‑probability estimation close the performance gap for proprietary generators without sacrificing robustness?
What vocabulary reduction or top‑k logit approximation techniques can retain detection strength while further lowering computational overhead?

papers.title: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework Defense against LLM Jailbreak Attacks
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that exploit techniques such as role-playing, obfuscation, code transformation, and multi-step indirection to elicit harmful outputs. As jailbreak strategies keep emerging, defenses have proliferated in an ongoing cat-and-mouse game, yet most remain static: their safety behavior is fixed at deployment, so they cannot accumulate defensive experience or adapt to unseen strategies. We propose a self-evolving test-time defense built around a persistent, cross-interaction rule memory: when an attack succeeds, the framework abstracts that failure into a method-level rule capturing the structural attack wrapper rather than the harmful topic, and reuses it against future inputs. Because rules are method-level, one induced rule generalizes across an entire attack family, and the label space expands as novel wrappers appear. The mechanism operates entirely through external memory and prompting, with no parameter updates, and applies to both open-weight and black-box API models. We realize it as four cooperating modules, but the contribution is the memory-based adaptation mechanism, not the module decomposition. Across four black-box jailbreak families and multiple models, our method substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving benign utility, remains robust under an adaptive composite-wrapper attack, and does not increase over-refusal as the memory grows.

summary.takeaway: 一种基于记忆的测试时防御，能够从 jailbreak 失败中学习，在不修改模型参数的情况下显著降低攻击成功率。
summary.why_for_you: 符合您对 LLM 自适应、parameter‑free 防御的兴趣，提供一种 test‑time 方法来缓解 jailbreak。
summary.method: 持久的外部规则记忆将失败的攻击抽象为方法级规则，并在 inference 时通过四个提示式代理应用。
summary.limitations: 评估仅限于四个攻击家族和有限的模型集合，每个标签的规则容量为 4 条。
summary.evidence: 在四个 black‑box jailbreak 家族中，系统在首批后将 ASR‑gpt 降至接近零，同时保持良好的实用性。
summary.problem: 静态安全机制无法在 inference 期间适应新出现的 jailbreak 策略。

signals.text: 引入持久规则记忆，将攻击包装器抽象化，在首次暴露后实现接近零的攻击成功率。
实现四个提示式代理，分别进行分类、检索、执行和反思，以在不更新模型权重的情况下生成 method‑level 规则。
在四个 black‑box jailbreak 家族中将 ASR‑gpt 降至接近零，尽管结果仅限于这些攻击和模型。

deep_dive.overview: 本文提出一种自演化的 test‑time 防御，将 method‑level 规则存储在外部记忆中。当 jailbreak 成功时，reflection 代理将结构化包装抽象为规则，triggering 代理据此检测未来相似输入。policy 代理根据匹配规则执行硬拒或软拒，response 代理生成最终输出。模型参数不被修改，可部署于 open‑weight 与 black‑box LLM API。

mechanism.detail: 而非特定主题的过滤器，规则抽象了结构化的攻击方法（例如，角色扮演-嵌套人格），使单个规则能够跨所有共享相同包装器的提示进行泛化，无论其有害意图如何。
mechanism.title: 方法级规则抽象

methodology.detail: 规则记忆Rt存储形式为[标签=Li] 如果请求使用Pi则Di的条目，其中Pi捕获攻击包装器，Di为拒绝约束；通过归纳增长，并按标签限制（C=4）。
methodology.title: 规则记忆与操作符

methodology.detail: A1（规则触发）运行分类器ϕ对输入进行标记并检索最多K=2个匹配规则；A2（策略决策）将触发规则映射为硬拒绝、软拒绝或允许；A3（响应生成）将策略作为动态系统指令注入；A4（自我反思）检测违规行为，通过操作符F生成新规则，并通过U更新记忆。
methodology.title: 四个提示代理

experiments.title: 评估设置
experiments.detail: 基准：AdvBench 与 CodeChameleon；模型：Qwen2.5‑7B、Llama3.1‑8B、Gemini‑3‑Flash‑Preview；攻击：四类黑盒 jailbreak 家族及 DeepInception；基线：No Defense、Defense Prompt、Self‑Reminder、AutoDefense；指标：ASR‑rej、ASR‑gpt、任务性能（MMLU、GSM8K）。

findings.title: 攻击成功率降低
findings.detail: ASR‑gpt 在首批 20 次攻击后降至接近零，并在所有四个家族中保持低水平；消融实验表明，移除任意代理都会显著提升 ASR，验证了其互补作用。

findings.title: 效用保持
findings.detail: 良性任务性能与基模型相当，且随着规则记忆扩展，过度拒绝并未增加。

contributions: 在测试时，Persistent external rule memory 累积结构化防御知识。
Method‑level rule abstraction 使跨 attack families 泛化。
Multi‑agent prompting architecture 在无需 parameter updates 的情况下实现 classification、retrieval、enforcement 和 reflection。
limitations: 实验仅覆盖四个 black‑box jailbreak families 以及有限的 LLMs。
Per‑label capacity (C=4) 可能限制对大量多样化 attack methods 的可扩展性。
缺乏针对 memory 的 formal safety guarantees 或对 adaptive adversaries 的分析。
open_questions: 当 rule memory 扩展至数百种多样化 wrappers 时，该方法的可扩展性如何？
adaptive attackers 能否构造提示规避或污染 rule induction process？
test‑time memory 与现有对齐技术（如 RLHF）之间的交互是什么？

papers.title: S3C-LLM: Skill-Code Guided Agentic Language Models for Spectrum-to-Structure Elucidation
papers.abstract: Spectroscopic structure elucidation is central to molecular analysis, but recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods mostly formulate it as direct spectrum-to-SMILES generation. Although this paradigm can leverage paired spectral data, it does not explicitly model the analytical workflow used by spectroscopists, such as diagnostic peak interpretation, fragment reasoning, formula constraints, and chemical consistency checking. In this paper, we introduce S3C-LLM, a skill-guided and code-grounded agentic LLM for spectrum-to-structure elucidation. Rather than directly predicting a molecule, S3C-LLM retrieves modality-specific spectroscopy skills, executes analysis code to instantiate these skills on the input spectra, and integrates the resulting peak-level evidence and formula constraints before generating SMILES. Specifically, we contribute a self-evolving spectroscopy skill library, a thinking-augmented skill-code trajectory construction pipeline, and a two-stage training strategy that teaches Qwen3-4B through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by our proposed step-level reinforcement learning (RL). Experiments on diverse benchmarks show that S3C-LLM consistently outperforms current general LLMs and spectrum-specific models across spectra, while using less than 1/10th of SpectraLLM's training corpus.

summary.takeaway: In this paper, we introduce S3C-LLM, a skill-guided and code-grounded agentic LLM for spectrum-to-structure elucidation.
summary.problem: Spectroscopic structure elucidation is central to molecular analysis, but recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods mostly formulate it as direct spectrum-to-SMILES generation.
summary.method: In this paper, we introduce S3C-LLM, a skill-guided and code-grounded agentic LLM for spectrum-to-structure elucidation.
summary.evidence: Experiments on diverse benchmarks show that S3C-LLM consistently outperforms current general LLMs and spectrum-specific models across spectra, while using less than 1/10th of SpectraLLM's training corpus.
summary.limitations: The abstract does not state complete limitations; verify the experimental setup, baselines, and scope before relying on the result.

papers.title: When Teacher Guidance Misleads: Reward-Aligned On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a popular post-training paradigm for large language models (LLMs), providing an efficient way to transfer the knowledge and capabilities of teacher models into student models. However, teacher guidance on student-generated prefixes is not always reliable. Training should optimize the model to generate responses that are more likely to be correct, or equivalently, to get higher outcome rewards. But during OPD, the teacher model may provide guidance that discourages the student from moving toward correct trajectories or moves the student toward incorrect ones, which is misaligned with outcome reward. Such misaligned guidance is unreliable, as it would mislead the optimization process and ultimately degrade model performance. To mitigate misaligned teacher guidance, we propose Reward-Aligned On-Policy Distillation (RA-OPD). The key insight is to keep only trajectories whose induced updates move the student toward correct trajectories or discourage the student from moving toward incorrect ones. Specifically, for each sampled trajectory, RA-OPD checks whether its trajectory-level distillation return is consistent with its outcome reward and then filters out the misaligned trajectories. RA-OPD selects more reliable trajectories to improve student model performance without requiring additional computational cost. We evaluate RA-OPD on math and code benchmarks using models from the Qwen3 family and the DeepSeek-R1 family. Across seven math benchmarks and three code benchmarks, RA-OPD significantly outperforms standard OPD and other tested OPD variants.

summary.why_for_you: 如果你从事 on‑policy distillation，RA-OPD 直接解决教师指导不对齐的问题，这是你研究中的关键障碍。
summary.limitations: 该方法依赖外部 verifier 提供二元奖励，当所有轨迹被过滤时可能导致更新为零。
summary.problem: 标准 OPD 可能被与 outcome rewards 冲突的教师指导误导，导致 student 性能下降。
summary.method: RA-OPD 计算轨迹层面的 distillation return，并丢弃其符号与二元 outcome reward 不一致的轨迹。
summary.evidence: 在七个数学和三个代码基准上，RA-OPD 将 avg@k 提升最高 5.20 分，优于标准 OPD。
summary.takeaway: RA-OPD 在 on‑policy distillation 过程中筛除 reward‑misaligned 轨迹，实现持续的性能提升。

signals.text: RA-OPD 筛除 reward‑misaligned 轨迹，使 OPD avg@k 在数学基准上提升最高 5.20 分。
RA-OPD 使用二元掩码 mi = 1[(2Ri‑1)Gi ≥0] 仅保留对齐轨迹，无需额外 rollout。
在 Qwen3‑4B‑Base 上，RA-OPD 达到 avg@k 45.88，较标准 OPD 高出 5.20 分；但其依赖 verifier 提供二元奖励。

deep_dive.overview: 本文指出 on‑policy distillation (OPD) 中的教师指导可能在轨迹层面与真实 outcome reward 不对齐，导致性能下降。提出 Reward‑Aligned OPD (RA‑OPD)，筛除其 distillation return 与 verifier 提供的二元正确性信号不一致的轨迹。该方法复用已有 OPD rollout，无需额外模型评估，并进行绝对一致性检查。对 Qwen3 与 DeepSeek‑R1 模型在多个数学和代码基准的实验表明，相较标准 OPD 和已有变体，性能持续提升。

methodology.title: 轨迹采样与回报计算
methodology.detail: 对于每个提示 qi，从 πθ 采样学生轨迹 τi，计算逐标记 reverse‑KL 项 ri,t，并聚合为轨迹层面的蒸馏回报 Gi = average_t ri,t。

methodology.title: 结果验证与掩码创建
methodology.detail: 获取二元奖励 Ri = Verify(qi, τi) ∈ {0,1}。定义掩码 mi = 1[(2Ri‑1)Gi ≥ 0]；若 mi=1 则保留轨迹，否则丢弃。

methodology.title: 策略更新
methodology.detail: 如果有轨迹被保留 (Z = Σ_i mi/|τi| > 0)，则最小化 RA‑OPD 损失 (Eq. 3)；否则将梯度设为零。

mechanism.title: 绝对奖励对齐准则
mechanism.detail: RA‑OPD 不采用多次 rollout 的相对一致性，而是逐条检查每条轨迹：正的蒸馏回报必须与正确的结果 (Ri=1) 对齐，负的回报必须与错误的结果 (Ri=0) 对齐。

mechanism.title: 零成本过滤
mechanism.detail: 该方法复用已为 OPD 计算的教师概率，因此对齐检查不增加额外的前向传播或 rollout。

experiments.title: 基准、模型和基线
experiments.detail: 数学：AIME24/25/26、AMC、MATH、Minerva Math、OlympiadBench，使用 Qwen3‑8B‑Base‑GRPO‑Math 教师和 Qwen3‑4B/8B‑Base 学生；代码：HumanEval+、MBPP+、LiveCodeBench v6，使用 Qwen3‑8B‑Base‑GRPO‑Code 教师和 DeepSeek‑R1‑Distill‑Qwen‑7B 学生。基线：standard OPD、ExOPD、G‑OPD、Uni‑OPD。

experiments.title: 指标
experiments.detail: 报告数学的 avg@k（k=32 或 8）和代码的 pass@k（k=4）。

findings.title: 数学性能提升
findings.detail: 在 Qwen3‑4B‑Base 上，RA‑OPD 达到 avg@k 45.88，比 standard OPD 提升 5.20 分，比 ExOPD 提升 3.52 分；在 Qwen3‑8B‑Base 上，平均提升 5.09 分（相较于 OPD）。

findings.title: 在各基准上持续优势
findings.detail: RA‑OPD 在七个数学基准中的六个以及全部三个代码基准上均领先所有竞争方法，显著提升包括 AIME24 上 +6.04、OlympiadBench 上 +2.08。

findings.title: 无额外计算成本
findings.detail: 过滤步骤复用已有的 OPD rollout，因此训练时间与 standard OPD 相同。

contributions: 引入 RA‑OPD，一种用于 on‑policy 蒸馏的轨迹级奖励对齐过滤器。
证明蒸馏回报与结果奖励的绝对一致性可提升学生模型性能。
在多样的数学和代码任务上提供大量实证验证，且无需额外计算。
limitations: 需要可靠的验证器为每条轨迹生成二元结果奖励。
若所有采样轨迹均被过滤 (Z=0)，方法将产生零梯度更新。
仅在可验证正确性的任务（数学、代码）上评估；对开放式生成的适用性尚未测试。
open_questions: 当验证器噪声较大或仅提供概率奖励时，RA‑OPD 的表现如何？
对不可验证或主观任务，能否扩展对齐过滤器？
轨迹过滤对收敛性和样本效率的理论影响是什么？
